title: Fallback policy derived from Exp 213 monitorability audit

request_structured_reasoning_when: Request structured_json for live_gsm8k_semantic_failure when semantic visibility and constraint coverage materially exceed terse output.
distrust_free_form_traces_when: Distrust free_form_reasoning on live_gsm8k_semantic_failure when free-form traces are less parseable or reveal less of the real constraint state than structured_json.

model_guidance.Qwen3.5-0.8B: Prefer structured_json over free_form_reasoning for audit-critical tasks.
